guides.intro: What a Combat rogue presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. Combat with swords is the rogue's fastest leveling spec in the fight lab, and the simplest: build combo points with **Sinister Strike**, spend them on **Eviscerate**, open from stealth once you have an opener worth the walk. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Sinister Strike and Eviscerate
stages.change: **Sinister Strike** builds combo points, **Eviscerate** spends them.
press: **Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**. Earlier when it would kill the mob.
notes: **Backstab** (4) is for daggers. This build plays swords: never Backstab.
**Stealth** (1) has nothing to open with yet and is not worth the walk: mobs die in a few hits. It gets its key at 14, with **Garrote**.

stages.title: Gouge
stages.change: **Gouge** stuns the mob for a few seconds: a breather.
press: **Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**. Earlier when it would kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: **Gouge**, then bandage or walk away while the mob stands stunned.

stages.title: Evasion
stages.change: **Evasion**: for half a minute the mob can barely hit you.
press: **Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**. Earlier when it would kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below half your health, while the mob has more than 30% of its own: **Evasion**. **Gouge** for a breather.

stages.title: Talents begin; Sprint and Sap
stages.change: Talent points start with **Coup de Grace**. Nothing new in the fight itself.
press: **Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**. Earlier when it would kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below half your health, while the mob has more than 30% of its own: **Evasion**. **Gouge** for a breather.
notes: **Slice and Dice** (10): leave it off your bar. The tuned rotation never casts it: a mob dies before the extra swings pay for the combo points.
**Sap** (10): a second mob next to your target, from stealth, before the pull.
**Kick** (12): the tuned rotation never interrupts. A caster that stands and casts walks to you when you close in, and the kill is faster without the detour.
**Coup de Grace** (10-12) makes every **Eviscerate** hit harder. **Precision** (15-17) makes your hits land.

stages.title: Garrote from stealth
stages.change: **Garrote**: open from stealth with a bleed. From here every fight starts in **Stealth**.
press: **Stealth** up behind the mob with full energy.
Open with **Garrote**.
**Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**. Earlier when it would kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below half your health, while the mob has more than 30% of its own: **Evasion**. **Gouge** for a breather.
notes: **Poised** (18) makes the opener 10 energy cheaper.
**Ambush** (18) is for daggers. **Expose Armor** (14) and **Rupture** (20) are never cast: the points are worth more as **Eviscerate**.

stages.title: Riposte
stages.change: **Riposte** (talent) lights up after you parry: a free strike that disarms.
press: **Stealth** up behind the mob with full energy.

**Riposte** after you parry.
**Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**. Earlier when it would kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below half your health, while the mob has more than 30% of its own: **Evasion**. **Gouge** for a breather.
notes: **Vanish** (22) is the emergency exit: the mob loses you, and you walk away.

stages.title: Shank
stages.change: **Shank**, a strike on a cooldown that also gives energy. Press it whenever it is ready.
press: **Stealth** up behind the mob with full energy.
Open with **Garrote**.
**Shank** whenever it is ready, unless the energy it gives would go over your maximum.
**Riposte** after you parry.
**Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**. Earlier when it would kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below half your health, while the mob has more than 30% of its own: **Evasion**. **Gouge** for a breather. **Vanish** is the emergency exit.
notes: **Cheap Shot** (26): off. The tuned rotation never casts it: **Garrote** is the better opener.
Put Instant Poison on your main hand once you have it. **Mind-numbing Poison** (24) is for casters in groups.

stages.title: Deadly Poison, Hack and Slash
stages.change: Nothing new to press. **Deadly Poison** goes on your off hand; **Hack and Slash** adds free swings.
press: **Stealth** up behind the mob with full energy.
Open with **Garrote**.
**Shank** whenever it is ready, unless the energy it gives would go over your maximum.

notes: **Deadly Poison** (30) on your off hand, Instant Poison on your main hand: buffs you reapply between fights, no key.
**Kidney Shot** (30): off. The tuned rotation never casts it.

stages.title: Nothing new to press
stages.change: The rotation is complete. The remaining points go to crit and energy; buy every new rank.
press: **Stealth** up behind the mob with full energy.
Open with **Garrote**.
**Shank** whenever it is ready, unless the energy it gives would go over your maximum.
**Riposte** after you parry.
**Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**. Earlier when it would kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below half your health, while the mob has more than 30% of its own: **Evasion**. **Gouge** for a breather. **Vanish** is the emergency exit.
notes: **Malice** (42-46) and **Lethality** (52-53) are crit; **Vigor** (50-51) is 10 more energy, so **Shank** overflows less often.
**Mutilate**, **Death Mark** and **Adrenaline Rush** belong to other builds. This one does not take them.

stages.title: Cold Blood
stages.change: **Cold Blood** (talent): a guaranteed critical **Eviscerate** every 3 minutes.
press: **Stealth** up behind the mob with full energy.
Open with **Garrote**.
**Shank** whenever it is ready, unless the energy it gives would go over your maximum.
**Riposte** after you parry.
**Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
**Cold Blood** right before an **Eviscerate** at 5 points, whenever it is ready.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**. Earlier when it would kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below half your health, while the mob has more than 30% of its own: **Evasion**. **Gouge** for a breather. **Vanish** is the emergency exit.

between: Bandage when you are below 60% of your health, eat when you are below 40%. That is the tuned rule.
Reapply your poisons when they run out, and **Stealth** before each pull from 14.
Visit the trainer every even level: **Sinister Strike** and **Eviscerate** have many ranks.
other: The Combat-Subtlety split is about 1% behind in the fight lab and plays **Ghostly Strike** and the stealth openers; Assassination with daggers plays **Mutilate** from 40. Both have pages in this folder.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; poisons, food, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. The scheme is the same on every class: Q the attack you press most, E the control, R the payoff, F the save, the thumb buttons the reactions, 1-4 the rest, the Shift bar the rarer tools. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes. Bold marks what arrives in that stage. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup: the [rogue keybinds page](keybinds.md).

slots.role: Your builder, pressed most; the macro also starts your swings
Control: a stun for a breather
Thumb reaction: lights up after a parry
A second mob, before the pull
Close a gap or open one

bars.title: Action bar 2: the same keys with Shift

slots.role: The interrupt the tuned rotation skips: for a caster that hits too hard

notes: WoW switches bar 1 to the stealth bar while you are in **Stealth** (as in Classic): put the same spells in the same slots on it. Otherwise nothing swaps: every key gets its spell once and keeps it.
**Stealth** sits on Shift+1, right above the opener on 1: press one, then the other, before each pull from 14.
No key: the poisons, **Slice and Dice**, **Cheap Shot** and **Kidney Shot** (the tuned rotation never casts them), food, bandages, the mount and the Hearthstone.
Levels 1-5 fight with Q and R. Q is a macro on the [keybinds page](keybinds.md) that also starts your swings, so the middle mouse button stays free. Add a key when its spell arrives.

Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

**Stealth** (1) has nothing to open with yet and is not worth the walk: mobs die in a few hits. It gets its key at 14, with **Garrote**.

stages.title: Garrote from stealth
stages.change: **Garrote**: open from stealth with a bleed. From here every fight starts in **Stealth**.
press: **Stealth** up behind the mob with full energy.
Open with **Garrote**.
**Kick** a caster mob's spell.

At 5 points: **Eviscerate**. Earlier when it would kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below half your health, while the mob has more than 30% of its own: **Evasion**. **Gouge** for a breather.
notes: **Poised** (18) makes the opener 10 energy cheaper.
**Ambush** (18) is not in this list: the rotation opens with **Garrote**, and the fight lab has not tried **Ambush** with it.
**Expose Armor** (14) and **Rupture** (20) are never cast: the points are worth more as **Eviscerate**.

**Ruthlessness** (15-17): a finisher often adds a combo point back. **Remorseless Attacks** (18-19) makes your first strike after a kill likelier to crit: pull the next mob within 20 seconds. **Lethality** (20-21) makes those crits bigger, **Vigor** (22-23) is 10 more energy.
Put **Instant Poison** on your main hand once you have it (20).
**Vanish** (22) is the emergency exit: the mob loses you, and you walk away.

stages.title: Cold Blood
stages.change: **Cold Blood** (talent): a guaranteed critical **Eviscerate** every 3 minutes.
press: **Stealth** up behind the mob with full energy.
Open with **Garrote**.
**Kick** a caster mob's spell.
**Shank** whenever it is ready, unless the energy it gives would go over your maximum.
**Sinister Strike** until you have 5 combo points.
**Cold Blood** right before an **Eviscerate** at 5 points, whenever it is ready.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**. Earlier when it would kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below half your health, while the mob has more than 30% of its own: **Evasion**. **Gouge** for a breather. **Vanish** is the emergency exit.
notes: Most fights below 30 end on a smaller **Eviscerate** that kills, so **Cold Blood** comes up rarely at first.
**Cheap Shot** (26): off. The tuned rotation never casts it: **Garrote** is the better opener.
**Vile Poisons** (26) and **Improved Poisons** (27-29, 32) make your poisons hit harder and more often.
**Deadly Poison** (30) on your off hand, **Instant Poison** on your main hand: buffs you reapply between fights, no key.
**Venom** (30): a **Shank** that lands makes your poisons stronger for 6 seconds. Nothing new to press.
**Kidney Shot** (30): off. The tuned rotation never casts it.
**Relentless Strikes** (31, 33-34, 38-39) gives a finisher a chance to refund 25 energy. **Seal Fate** (35-37): a builder that crits adds a second combo point.
**Blind** (34) handles a second mob that joins mid-fight.

stages.title: Mutilate
stages.change: **Mutilate** (talent) takes over from **Sinister Strike**: both daggers strike, 2 combo points a press.
press: **Stealth** up behind the mob with full energy.
Open with **Garrote**.
**Kick** a caster mob's spell.
**Shank** whenever it is ready, unless the energy it gives would go over your maximum. With **Venom** it also makes your poisons stronger for 6 seconds.
**Mutilate** until you have 5 combo points. Wait for its 60 energy rather than press your old builder.
**Cold Blood** right before an **Eviscerate** at 5 points, whenever it is ready.
At 5 points: **Eviscerate**. Earlier when it would kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below half your health, while the mob has more than 30% of its own: **Evasion**. **Gouge** for a breather. **Vanish** is the emergency exit.
notes: Q keeps its job: change the Q macro's spell to **Mutilate** (the [macros page](../macros.md) has it).
**Mutilate** hits 20% harder on a poisoned mob: keep **Deadly Poison** on your off hand.

From 41 the points go to Combat: **Lightning Reflexes** (41-42) is dodge, **Coup de Grace** (43-45) a bigger **Eviscerate**, **Puncturing Wounds** (46-48) crit on **Mutilate**, **Precision** (49-51) hit, **Deflection** (52-53) parry, **Composure** (54-55) a cheaper opener, **Flawless Execution** (56) a cheaper **Eviscerate**, **Aggression** (57-58) a harder one, **Weapon Expertise** (59-60) fewer dodges and parries.
**Adrenaline Rush**, **Blade Flurry** and **Riposte** belong to Combat builds. This one does not take them.

between: Bandage when you are below 60% of your health, eat when you are below 40%. That is the tuned rule.
Reapply your poisons when they run out, and **Stealth** before each pull from 14.
Visit the trainer every even level: **Sinister Strike**, **Garrote** and **Eviscerate** have many ranks, and **Mutilate** has new ranks at 50 and 60.
other: Combat with swords is the rogue's fastest leveling spec in the fight lab and builds with **Sinister Strike** all the way; the Subtlety and Combat-Subtlety builds open with **Premeditation** and **Ambush** and strike with **Ghostly Strike**. Each has a page in this folder.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; poisons, food, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. The scheme is the same on every class: Q the attack you press most, E the control, R the payoff, F the save, the thumb buttons the reactions, 1-4 the rest, the Shift bar the rarer tools. Every spell this spec shares with Combat sits on the Combat key, so your hands do not relearn anything when you switch specs. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes. Bold marks what arrives in that stage. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup and the macros: the [rogue keybinds page](keybinds.md).

WoW switches bar 1 to a second page while you are in **Stealth** (the stealth bar, as in Classic). Put the same spells in the same slots on it, so every key does the same thing in and out of Stealth.

Before each pull: Shift+1 (**Stealth**), Shift+Q (**Premeditation**, when it is ready), then 1 (**Garrote**) or C (**Ambush**). Stealth and Premeditation are off the global cooldown, so the three go one after the other.
No key: the poisons, **Slice and Dice** and **Kidney Shot** (the tuned rotation never casts them), **Cheap Shot** and **Backstab** (not in this list), food, bandages, the mount and the Hearthstone.

guides.intro: What a Combat-Subtlety rogue presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. This split plays Subtlety's rotation with a dagger in each hand: **Premeditation** and **Ambush** put combo points on the mob before your first builder, **Ghostly Strike**, its signature strike, goes in on its cooldown, and Combat's talents add hit, dodge and cheaper finishers. **Sinister Strike** stays your builder until **Hemorrhage** arrives at 60. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.
